tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page ground. Light is the primary theme; Dark is the black section theme (footer, closing bands).

tokens.name: surface-container
tokens.usage: Quiet panels, newsletter and table grounds. Source tokens: rl-grey and mono-light-black.

tokens.name: surface-container-higher
tokens.usage: Progress tracks, dividers that must be seen.

tokens.name: on-surface
tokens.usage: Headlines, body, labels on every surface token. 16.8:1 on surface in Light, 21:1 in Dark.

tokens.name: on-surface-variant
tokens.usage: Roles, captions and secondary copy on surface and surface-container (5.0:1 / 4.6:1 in Light, 6.3:1 in Dark). On surface-container-high it is 4.3:1: use on-surface there.

tokens.name: tab-muted
tokens.usage: SOURCE VALUE (50% ink). Inactive tab labels. Only 3.3:1 on white, so it fails 4.5:1 for 13px text. Use tab-muted-safe.

tokens.name: tab-muted-safe
tokens.usage: SAFE ALTERNATIVE for inactive tab labels. 4.7:1 on white in Light, 8.0:1 on black in Dark.

tokens.name: outline-hairline
tokens.usage: Section dividers, tab rules, table row lines. Decorative; never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: outline-strong
tokens.usage: 2px edge of the outlined button and inputs. 16.8:1.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Primary button fill, links, active accents. White on it is 5.0:1. Source name: rl-blue.

tokens.name: primary-hover
tokens.usage: SOURCE VALUE for the primary hover fill. White text on it is 3.3:1 (fails 4.5:1 at 16px). Keep for look; use primary-hover-safe where legibility matters.

tokens.name: primary-hover-safe
tokens.usage: SAFE ALTERNATIVE hover. White on #0043ce is 7.8:1. In Dark the source hover #4589ff is kept (6.3:1 against black).

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Text links and small icons. 5.0:1 on surface in Light, 6.3:1 on surface in Dark. On surface-container (f5f5f7) use primary-hover-safe (7.1:1).

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 2px solid outline, 2px offset, on every interactive element.

tokens.name: glass-fill
tokens.usage: Glass secondary button over photos (10% white, backdrop blur 35px).

tokens.name: glass-fill-strong
tokens.usage: Glass pill with trailing circle (20% white, blur 2px).

tokens.name: glass-card-fill
tokens.usage: Testimonial and stat cards over photography (10% blue-grey, blur).

tokens.name: glass-card-border-soft
tokens.usage: 1px edge of the lighter 4-up glass boxes (32% white).

tokens.name: on-photo
tokens.usage: Headlines over photography or gradient fields. Needs a photo-scrim: contrast depends on the image.

tokens.name: photo-scrim
tokens.usage: INFERRED safe layer (40% black) under white text on bright sky art. Not in the source.

tokens.name: night
tokens.usage: Ground of the black section and dark fields.

tokens.name: blue-dark
tokens.usage: Dark text on light-blue chips (11.5:1 on blue-light).

tokens.name: sky
tokens.usage: Gradient stop and hover. Same value as primary-hover.

tokens.name: orange
tokens.usage: Accent and dusk glows. Never as text.

tokens.name: yellow
tokens.usage: Highlights. Never as text on white.

tokens.name: success-text
tokens.usage: Positive status text. 5.0:1 on surface, 4.6:1 on success-soft (Light).

tokens.name: danger-text
tokens.usage: Risk status text. 5.0:1 on surface, 4.6:1 on danger-soft (Light).

families.sans: "Inter Tight", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif

styles.name: display-hero
styles.usage: Hero headline over a photo field. Measured 56/67.2 at 1440. Fluid: clamp(36px, 3.9vw, 56px).

styles.name: display-blur
styles.usage: Large blur-in statements (the source sets these at 4rem). Fluid: clamp(40px, 4.4vw, 64px).

styles.name: heading-1
styles.usage: Section headline, stat numerals (600 for stats). Fluid: clamp(32px, 3.3vw, 48px).

styles.name: heading-2
styles.usage: Feature headline (39.056 measured, fractional from fluid sizing). Fluid: clamp(28px, 2.7vw, 39px).

styles.name: heading-3
styles.usage: Sub-headline and banner heading (500 weight in banners). Fluid: clamp(24px, 2.2vw, 31px).

styles.name: lead
styles.usage: Lead paragraph under a headline, person names.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default paragraph and button label. Letter-spacing normal.

styles.name: tab-label
styles.usage: Uppercase side-tab labels. 11px under 767px. Letter-spacing inferred; the source sets normal.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Mobile page margin, card inner gap.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Large button side padding, gap between cards (24px), mt-24 rhythm.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Hero field, 4-up glass boxes, testimonial cards, CTA field.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons (40px on a 47px button is a full pill).

tokens.name: radius-pill-xl
tokens.usage: Glass pill with a trailing circle.

tokens.name: shadow-underline
tokens.usage: Blue 4px underline on active links (8px on large).

tokens.name: shadow-focus
tokens.usage: INFERRED soft halo behind the 2px focus ring.

blur.note: backdrop-filter radii measured in the source stylesheet.

tokens.name: blur-xs
tokens.usage: Text and light glass pills (outline pill).

duration.note: Measured from the stylesheet and the page's reveal script.

tokens.name: dur-instant
tokens.usage: Background and colour on small controls.

tokens.name: dur-base
tokens.usage: Default (`transition: all .3s` on buttons and cards).

tokens.name: dur-word
tokens.usage: Blur-in words: opacity, transform and filter.

tokens.name: dur-stagger
tokens.usage: Delay added per word in blur-in.

easing.note: The source uses the browser default `ease` and `linear`; it declares no custom curves.

tokens.name: page-margin
tokens.usage: Nav and section side margin at 1440.

tokens.name: hero-inset
tokens.usage: Hero field sits 36px in from each side (1368 wide).

tokens.name: utility-height
tokens.usage: Utility strip above the nav (contact, support, log in).

tokens.name: card-width
tokens.usage: Tall feature card; two per row with a 24px gap.

tokens.name: tabs-width
tokens.usage: Left sticky tab column; content starts at 336px.
